facts.text: The window booth at Harlem Late-Night Diner, after midnight.
facts.why: The still above it shows Shaft on a street, not sitting in a diner booth.
facts.fix: Shaft out on the street, before the diner.

vibe.verdict: Neon diner and Bumpy Jonas jokes suit the film, but the food is generic and the best scenes are unused.
